thread:
peter: Heads-up: Support ticket where provisional tokens balloon after fast reconnects during streaming toolcalls. Looks like dedupe key isn't catching replays.
anya: Which signals do we have in traces? session_id present? prefix hash?
peter: Example: ```
[INFO] session=orgZ attempt=A1 prefix=0xdead tool_call tokens=200
[INFO] network drop -> reconnect after 3s attempt=A2 session=orgZ prefix=0xdead tool_call provisional=true tokens=200
[INFO] final_ack A2 confirmed=true
```
ryan: Deduped on attempt id today so A1/A2 are separate. If A1 never made it to ledger (crash before provisional emit), we only see A2 provisional then confirmed. Console shows provisional spike and customers worry.
billing-bot: billing-bot: Recommend ledger tags: provisional_reason=(replay|truncation|client_retry), original_attempt_id, and provisional_hold (true/false). Include in CSV.
anya: Short-term: router heuristic: if session_id present and reconnect within 10s and prefix matches, mark replay with original_attempt_id and provisional_replay flag. Ledger should not finalize replayed provisional until final ack.
ryan: Telemetry: emit `replay_hint` (bool), `resume_seq`, `reconnect_origin` (client|network|router), and `original_attempt_ts` when known.
console-bot: console-bot: UX idea: default view = confirmed cost; add toggle "Include provisional" and a hover explaining provisional semantics. Add org alert when provisional - confirmed > 500 tokens in 5m.
peter: Long-term: persist short-lived attempt->session map (TTL 2m) so replays can be correlated after router restarts. Also push SDK change to always set session_id+resume_seq.
anya: I'll draft a tiny RFC for dedupe key change + telemetry and mock console copy. Assign infra + billing tasks once reviewed.
ryan: I'll prototype router change and tag ledger rows as provisional_replay. pairing with @anya.
console-bot: noted. I'll add mock to the RFC.
